{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01DPCUpy5PtaCoKMLaSBpEay","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t---\n2\tname: se2-node-static-export\n3\tdescription: Scaffold-ETH 2 Next.js static export (IPFS build) crashes on Node >=23 due to a global localStorage\n4\tmetadata: \n5\t  node_type: memory\n6\t  type: project\n7\t  originSessionId: 2ee6c09f-05f4-414a-b582-02feea8e809f\n8\t  modified: 2026-07-24T16:51:28.063Z\n9\t---\n10\t\n11\tIn the ethskills-evals SE-2 workspaces, `NEXT_PUBLIC_IPFS_BUILD=true yarn next:build`\n12\t(Next.js static `output: \"export\"`) fails prerendering the stock `/_not-found`\n13\tpage with `TypeError: localStorage.getItem is not a function`.\n14\t\n15\t**Cause:** Node >=23 (env default here is 25.9.0) exposes a global `localStorage`\n16\tobject; wagmi/burner-connector code that guards with `typeof localStorage !==\n17\t\"undefined\"` then runs during SSR prerender and blows up. Node 20/22 have no\n18\tglobal `localStorage`, so the guard works.\n19\t\n20\t**Fix:** build with Node 20 or 22 LTS (`nvm use`, e.g. 22.2.0 is installed and\n21\tverified). Do NOT bake `--no-experimental-webstorage` into NODE_OPTIONS — that\n22\tflag errors on Node <22.4.\n23\t\n24\tAlso: `scaffold.config.ts` `targetNetworks` must be a single concrete network\n25\t(compile-time value the contract types derive from). A runtime env ternary makes\n26\tit a union type and collapses `ContractName` to the intersection of both\n27\tnetworks' contracts, breaking type-check.\n28\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"fdd305ee-c463-4217-92a5-2ec1f2e3ea82","uuid":"866a1c26-f76e-4faa-bc28-7a6a6fab2dfa","timestamp":"2026-07-24T17:09:36.387Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/Users/spencerfaber/.claude/projects/-Users-spencerfaber-dev-ethskills-evals/memory/se2-node-static-export.md","content":"---\nname: se2-node-static-export\ndescription: Scaffold-ETH 2 Next.js static export (IPFS build) crashes on Node >=23 due to a global localStorage\nmetadata: \n  node_type: memory\n  type: project\n  originSessionId: 2ee6c09f-05f4-414a-b582-02feea8e809f\n  modified: 2026-07-24T16:51:28.063Z\n---\n\nIn the ethskills-evals SE-2 workspaces, `NEXT_PUBLIC_IPFS_BUILD=true yarn next:build`\n(Next.js static `output: \"export\"`) fails prerendering the stock `/_not-found`\npage with `TypeError: localStorage.getItem is not a function`.\n\n**Cause:** Node >=23 (env default here is 25.9.0) exposes a global `localStorage`\nobject; wagmi/burner-connector code that guards with `typeof localStorage !==\n\"undefined\"` then runs during SSR prerender and blows up. Node 20/22 have no\nglobal `localStorage`, so the guard works.\n\n**Fix:** build with Node 20 or 22 LTS (`nvm use`, e.g. 22.2.0 is installed and\nverified). Do NOT bake `--no-experimental-webstorage` into NODE_OPTIONS — that\nflag errors on Node <22.4.\n\nAlso: `scaffold.config.ts` `targetNetworks` must be a single concrete network\n(compile-time value the contract types derive from). A runtime env ternary makes\nit a union type and collapses `ContractName` to the intersection of both\nnetworks' contracts, breaking type-check.\n","numLines":28,"startLine":1,"totalLines":28}}}

Do NOT bake `--no-experimental-webstorage` into NODE_OPTIONS — that\nflag errors on Node <22.4.","new_string":"**Fix A (Node 20/22):** build with Node 20 or 22 LTS (`nvm use`, e.g. 22.2.0 is\ninstalled and verified). Do NOT bake `--no-experimental-webstorage` into\nNODE_OPTIONS — that flag errors on Node <22.4.\n\n**Fix B (works on Node 25, verified):** ship a `packages/nextjs/polyfill-localstorage.cjs`\nthat reinstalls the WebStorage methods when a global `localStorage` exists but\nlacks `getItem`, and inject it with `NODE_OPTIONS=\"--require ./polyfill-localstorage.cjs\"`.\nMust use `--require` (not `instrumentation.ts`) so it loads in every prerender\nworker. Add the same NODE_OPTIONS to the nextjs `dev`/`start` scripts too —\notherwise `next dev` SSR throws the same error on Node 25 (page still hydrates\nclient-side, but client components fail to SSR). Polyfill is a no-op on Node 20/22.","originalFile":"---\nname: se2-node-static-export\ndescription: Scaffold-ETH 2 Next.js static export (IPFS build) crashes on Node >=23 due to a global localStorage\nmetadata: \n  node_type: memory\n  type: project\n  originSessionId: 2ee6c09f-05f4-414a-b582-02feea8e809f\n  modified: 2026-07-24T16:51:28.063Z\n---\n\nIn the ethskills-evals SE-2 workspaces, `NEXT_PUBLIC_IPFS_BUILD=true yarn next:build`\n(Next.js static `output: \"export\"`) fails prerendering the stock `/_not-found`\npage with `TypeError: localStorage.getItem is not a function`.\n\n**Cause:** Node >=23 (env default here is 25.9.0) exposes a global `localStorage`\nobject; wagmi/burner-connector code that guards with `typeof localStorage !==\n\"undefined\"` then runs during SSR prerender and blows up. Node 20/22 have no\nglobal `localStorage`, so the guard works.\n\n**Fix:** build with Node 20 or 22 LTS (`nvm use`, e.g. 22.2.0 is installed and\nverified). Do NOT bake `--no-experimental-webstorage` into NODE_OPTIONS — that\nflag errors on Node <22.4.\n\nAlso: `scaffold.config.ts` `targetNetworks` must be a single concrete network\n(compile-time value the contract types derive from). Here's the summary.\n\n## What was built\n\nA USDC tip jar for Base on Scaffold-ETH 2 (Foundry), developed against a **local Base fork** with a **static IPFS** production path.\n\n**Contract** — `packages/foundry/contracts/TipJar.sol`\n- `tip(amount, message)` pulls USDC via `SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom` (approve-first), appends to an on-chain feed, tracks totals, emits `NewTip`; reverts on zero amount.\n- `getRecentTips(count)` newest-first bounded read, `totalTipped`, `totalTippedBy`, owner-only `withdraw()`.\n- USDC address is fixed at deploy (`DeployTipJar.s.sol` → real Base USDC), so it's identical on the fork and on Base.\n- `test/TipJar.t.sol`: **7 tests pass**, including a fuzz test.\n\n**Frontend** — `app/page.tsx` + `components/tipjar/{TipForm,TipFeed}.tsx`\n- Feed reads `getRecentTips`/`totalTipped`; form does the approve→tip flow with separate `isMining` state per button, balance/allowance guards, `<Address>` for identities, DaisyUI throughout.\n- `externalContracts.ts` registers USDC for both `31337` (fork) and `8453` (Base).\n\n**Two constraints, both satisfied and verified:**\n\n1. **Local demo against real Base state, no real money at risk** — `README.md` documents the exact 3-terminal workflow (`yarn fork base` → `yarn deploy` → `yarn start`), plus seeding two test identities (Anvil Alice/Bob) with **real USDC** by impersonating a verified Base whale on the fork. I ran the whole flow with `cast`: whale → Alice(100)/Bob(50) USDC → each approved + tipped → jar holds 15 USDC, `tipsCount=2`, feed returns both newest-first. All fork-local; nothing touches mainnet.\n\n2. **Static IPFS build, no upload** — production config is in place (`next.config.ts` export/trailingSlash, `polyfill-localstorage.cjs` for Node 25, `getMetadata` honoring `NEXT_PUBLIC_PRODUCTION_URL`). `DEPLOY.md` has the exact clean-build, `yarn bgipfs upload out`, and post-deploy `curl` verification commands. I ran the build: succeeds, routes are trailing-slash directories, OG image is absolute, TipJar address baked into chunks. **Not uploaded anywhere.**\n\n**Verified:** `forge test` (7/7), `tsc --noEmit` clean, `yarn lint` clean (in build), IPFS build output correct, and a live dev-server SSR check showing the form + feed render with zero `localStorage` errors (I added the polyfill to the `dev`/`start` scripts so local dev is clean on Node 25 too).\n\nBackground fork/dev processes were cleaned up. One follow-up before a real ship (out of scope here, noted in `DEPLOY.md`): set `targetNetworks: [chains.base]` + a private Base RPC, and optionally a branded OG thumbnail."}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":750,"cache_read_input_tokens":106762,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":750,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"fdd305ee-c463-4217-92a5-2ec1f2e3ea82","uuid":"65ce496b-0ca5-4f26-8288-de85d270e561","timestamp":"2026-07-24T17:10:05.396Z","request_id":"req_011CdMFbRdAhGaVjQ67oNVwf"}
